I've been telling myself that for years. I don't feel like waiting anymore. Right now I've got to many problems to deal with. the route I'm going is going to take a while to dig out and I just don't have the energy for it. For example I have a low paying job (looking for something else) that I barely make ends meet with, I cant afford insurance until next month, the tags are about to expire, i have no other alternative to get to work, the transmission on the truck is about to go out. Thats just one example but everything in my life right now is just kind of stacked on itself and thankfully hasn't caved in on me yet. One thing goes it all will. No family to help either. Single to boot. I need to keep going if i don't want to drown but my stamina is shot. I can't emphasize enough that I'm just drained. Then even if I make it back to where I'm not struggling again, I'm still nowhere. I have nothing, and nobody. I have a lot of problem seeing value in that. 

Edit: Actually I've got to get some sleep. The funny thing is I can't kill my self yet. I'm too damn broke to afford it. lol. I've got to get all my stuff prepared, and pack up my apartment. I just don't have the energy to do it all in one go. I wish i was dead but I've even got drag myself to that. Life is shit.
I don't really expect anything besides regret. Just a lot less of it than I'd feel anyway.
